name: todev
description: Plan your day, projects, clients and invoices in ToDev, the planner for freelancers.

interface.longDescription:
ToDev keeps a freelancer's work in one place: tasks with due days, client projects, clients, and the invoices you send and the bills you pay. Connect it and ask what's due today, add tasks as you talk, move them to another day, or close a project when it's done.

For money, it records income and expenses in your account currency, marks invoices paid, and tells you what clients owe you, what's overdue, and the totals for any period. When you share an invoice or receipt in the chat, it reads it, records the amount and dates, and gives you a one-time link to attach the file.

It never deletes anything: removing records stays in the ToDev app. When you connect, the ToDev sign-in page lists what is being asked for, such as seeing your data or also creating and updating it, and you allow or deny. You can disconnect at any time in ToDev under Settings → Connected apps.

It works with any ToDev account, and plan limits apply as in the app. Invoices and clients need your company set up first, which can be done from the chat. ToDev records invoices you describe; it doesn't send them or move money.
defaultPrompt: What's on today, and what am I behind on?
Add three tasks to my website project for this week.
What do clients owe me right now?

positive.description: Today's work and what is late
positive.prompt: What's on today, and what am I behind on?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open tasks due today or earlier, with the overdue ones marked, and the overdue AC-009 invoice from Acme Corp.

positive.prompt: List my projects with their clients.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Northwind website rebuild (Northwind Bakery), Fjord Fitness app MVP (Fjord Fitness) and Acme maintenance (Acme Corp).

positive.description: Add a task to a project
positive.prompt: Add a task 'Prepare the demo' to the Fjord project for next Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Fjord Fitness app MVP project and creates 'Prepare the demo' due next Monday; asking for this week's tasks afterwards shows it.

positive.prompt: Record a 450 EUR invoice to Acme for October maintenance, due in 14 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Records a pending 450.00 EUR income invoice for Acme Corp due 14 days from today; it then appears in the list of unpaid invoices.

positive.prompt: How much income is still unpaid or overdue, and what were my income and expenses last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives unpaid and overdue income for all time, and last month's paid income and expenses, as EUR totals from the account, without inventing figures.

negative.description: Deleting is not available: ToDev's tools never delete. The assistant should say that deleting happens in the ToDev app and not change anything else instead.
No payments: ToDev records invoices but does not move money or send invoices. The assistant should decline and offer to mark the invoice paid once the money has arrived.
negative.prompt: Pay the Northwind invoice by bank transfer and email it to the client.

negative.description: Only the connected account: ToDev only reaches the signed-in user's own data. The assistant should say it can't see another person's tasks.
negative.prompt: Show me the tasks of todevlist@gmail.com.

review.commerce_description: ToDev doesn't sell anything in ChatGPT or process payments. It records invoices and expenses the user describes.

publication.release_notes: First release: today's work, tasks, projects, clients, invoices and expenses, and money summaries for a ToDev account. 17 tools, none of which delete.
